content.value: A brass plate (K = 115 W/mK) of thickness 6 cm is subjected to a constant uniform heat flux 10 $\mathrm { { k W / m ^ { 2 } } }$ at the boundary surface at ${ \bf x } \ = \ 0 .$ Heat is dissipated by convection from the other boundary surface into a fluid at a temperature of 90°C with a convective heat transfer coefficient of 400 $\mathrm { W / m } ^ { 2 } \mathrm { K }$ Calculate the surface temperatures of the slab.
